This is pseudocode for clmulh, the high half of a carry-less (GF(2) polynomial) product. It is not an ordinary integer multiplication. It shows only loosely related high-half semantics and says nothing about signed or unsigned operand interpretation.
packw packs the low halves of two registers. It is not a multiplication.
